wstep: There is no recipe here for spicy rhubarb chutney with onion and raisins. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: The Chutneys section of the NCHFP website lists four recipes: Apple, Mango, Tomato-Apple and Cranberry Orange Chutney. [T:ACI-646]
The FDA list gives white onions a pH of about 5.37–5.85. [T:ACI-107]
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods have a pH above 4.6 unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar. [T:ACI-006]

akapity: Rhubarb chutney with onion and raisins is not one of these four recipes. [T:ACI-646]
The FDA list gives rhubarb a pH of about 3.10–3.40. [T:ACI-143]
The whole product needs a minimum, uniform level of acid to prevent the growth of botulism bacteria. [T:ACI-017]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for rhubarb chutney with onion and raisins from a checked source. [T:-]
